Nina (partnerships): Quick sync: drafting partner playbook for the edge runtime shim. Need deprecation window, fallback behavior, and marketplace ingestion notes. Proposing 6mo notice + one-release fallback shim.
Kai (eng-runtime): 6mo OK. We can ship binary shims for x86 and arm64; won't cover custom quantized ops.
Alex (partner-eng): Marketplace needs signed artifacts and reproducible builds. Also partners often ask for notarized macOS binaries.
Sam (legal): Use "grace period" and "best-effort compatibility" wording to avoid extra obligations. Add export-control checklist for on-prem.
Daniel (product): Rollout plan: internal canary -> partner opt-in -> 50% marketplace -> full. Add automated fallback to hosted variant if telemetry exceeds thresholds.
Kai (eng-runtime): Telemetry gate idea: P95 token latency +30% or error rate >0.5% for 10m triggers circuit to route to hosted. I'll supply a config snippet.
Alex (partner-eng): Offer binary shim as primary, SDK shim transitional and unsupported for custom patches. Provide partner checklist (OS/arch, runtime min, env vars, sample canary YAML).
deploy-bot: deploy #edge-shim-prototype succeeded to staging - build 2026.03.22-87a1.
Nina (partnerships): Action items: Nina - comms + partner invite; Alex - checklist; Kai - telemetry + test harness; Sam - legal review; Daniel - loop in marketplace ops. Will post draft doc link here when ready.
